# Layers panel (`layers-panel`)

Layers with visibility, lock, thumbnails, groups and reorder.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createLayersPanel` (types in `dist/web/media/layersPanel.d.ts`): `mountLayersPanel` on a new `<div>`.

```ts
export function createLayersPanel(options: LayersPanelOptions): LayersPanelHandle;

export interface LayersPanelOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the list ("Layers"). */
  label: string;
  layers: readonly LayerItem[];
  selected?: string | null;
  labels?: Partial<LayersPanelLabels>;
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  onVisibleChange?: (id: string, visible: boolean) => void;
  onLockedChange?: (id: string, locked: boolean) => void;
  onExpandedChange?: (id: string, expanded: boolean) => void;
  /** A layer moved within its parent (`null` for the top level) to `index`; `layers` is the new tree. */
  onReorder?: (id: string, parentId: string | null, index: number, layers: LayerItem[]) => void;
}

export interface LayersPanelHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getLayers(): LayerItem[];
  setLayers(layers: readonly LayerItem[]): void;
  setSelected(id: string | null): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

/** One layer. The first in a list is the front-most. A layer with `children` is a group. */
export interface LayerItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Picture of the layer (a URL); groups and layers without one show `icon`. */
  thumbnail?: string | null;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Default true. */
  visible?: boolean;
  locked?: boolean;
  children?: readonly LayerItem[];
  /** Groups only; default true. */
  expanded?: boolean;
}

export interface LayersPanelLabels {
  hint: string;
  move: (name: string) => string;
  moved: (name: string, position: number, count: number) => string;
  hide: (name: string) => string;
  lock: (name: string) => string;
  contents: (name: string) => string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiFormatText, mdiImageOutline } from '@mdi/js';
import { createLayersPanel, createText, type LayerItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const layers: LayerItem[] = [
  { id: 'title', name: 'Title', icon: mdiFormatText },
  {
    id: 'scenery',
    name: 'Scenery',
    children: [
      { id: 'tree', name: 'Tree', icon: mdiImageOutline },
      { id: 'sun', name: 'Sun', icon: mdiImageOutline, visible: false },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'sky', name: 'Sky', icon: mdiImageOutline, locked: true },
];

const status = createText('Drag a grip, or press Up and Down on it, to reorder.', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const panel = createLayersPanel({
  label: 'Layers',
  layers,
  selected: 'tree',
  onSelect: (id) => (status.textContent = `Selected ${id}`),
  onVisibleChange: (id, visible) => (status.textContent = `${id} ${visible ? 'shown' : 'hidden'}`),
  onReorder: (id, parent, index) => (status.textContent = `${id} moved to ${index + 1}${parent ? ` in ${parent}` : ''}`),
});

document.body.append(panel.el, status);
```

## React API

`LayersPanel` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Builds `mountLayersPanel` into a `<div>` it renders; same DOM and classes once mounted. New `layers` or `selected` props redraw it.

```ts
export function LayersPanel({ label, layers, selected = null, labels, className, ...callbacks }: LayersPanelProps);

  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;

  onExpandedChange?: (id: string, expanded: boolean) => void;
  onReorder?: (id: string, parentId: string | null, index: number, layers: LayerItem[]) => void;

}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiFormatText, mdiImageOutline } from '@mdi/js';
import { LayersPanel } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { updateLayer, type LayerItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const LAYERS: LayerItem[] = [
  { id: 'title', name: 'Title', icon: mdiFormatText },
  {
    id: 'scenery',
    name: 'Scenery',
    children: [
      { id: 'tree', name: 'Tree', icon: mdiImageOutline },
      { id: 'sun', name: 'Sun', icon: mdiImageOutline, visible: false },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'sky', name: 'Sky', icon: mdiImageOutline, locked: true },
];

export function LayersPanelExample() {
  const [layers, setLayers] = useState(LAYERS);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>('tree');
  return (
    <LayersPanel
      label="Layers"
      layers={layers}
      selected={selected}
      onSelect={setSelected}
      onVisibleChange={(id, visible) => setLayers((list) => updateLayer(list, id, { visible }))}
      onLockedChange={(id, locked) => setLayers((list) => updateLayer(list, id, { locked }))}
      onExpandedChange={(id, expanded) => setLayers((list) => updateLayer(list, id, { expanded }))}
      onReorder={(_id, _parent, _index, next) => setLayers(next)}
    />
  );
}
```
